title: Badge
description: A small count or status indicator attached to the corner of another element.

support.notes: Native Angular: MnBadge. Native standalone component/directive; see platform tests for validated scope.

api.notes: Native Angular: MnBadge. Native standalone component/directive; see platform tests for validated scope.

vars.name: --badge-bg
vars.description: Background color (overrides the color and variant)

vars.name: --badge-fg
vars.description: Text color (overrides the color and variant)

vars.name: --badge-border
vars.description: Border color of the subtle and outline variants

vars.name: --badge-ring-color
vars.description: Color of the ring separating an attached (corner) badge from its content (defaults to --surface-color)

translationResources.title: Badge
translationResources.description: A small count or status indicator attached to the corner of another element.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Notification and message badges show 5 and 99+; inline badges mark Inbox 12 and a New changelog.

colors.title: Colors
colors.description: color sets the semantic color: primary (default), neutral, success, warning, danger and info.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: variant sets the visual style: solid (default), subtle (tinted background) or outline (bordered). Every variant works with every color.

positions.title: Positions
positions.description: Attach the badge to any corner with position.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: Three sizes: small, medium (default) and large.

dot.title: Dot
dot.description: dot replaces the content with a small dot, for "something new" indicators.

with-icon.title: With icon
with-icon.description: icon is displayed before the content.

custom-style.title: Custom styles
custom-style.description: borderRadius and borderWidth adjust the shape. To change the colors, set the CSS custom properties --badge-bg, --badge-fg and --badge-border (inline, in a class or on a parent element).

status.title: Status dot
status.description: A standalone dot next to a text label shows the status of an item or the presence of a user. Give the dot role="presentation" when the text already names the status, or an aria-label otherwise.

BadgeProps.children: Element the badge is attached to. Without children (or with plain text / number children, used as the content) the badge renders inline in the normal flow instead of being positioned on a corner
BadgeProps.className: Additional class name of the badge
BadgeProps.variant: Visual style: solid (filled), subtle (tinted background) or outline (bordered)
BadgeProps.content: Content displayed inside the badge (count, short text, icon + text...). Use it instead of children for rich content of a standalone badge
BadgeProps.position: Corner of the children the badge is placed on (ignored by standalone badges)
BadgeProps.dot: Renders a small dot instead of content
BadgeProps.aria-label: Accessible label of the badge, e.g. "5 unread messages"
BadgeProps.ref: Ref to the root element: the wrapper when attached to children, otherwise the badge itself
BadgeProps.role: ARIA role of the badge element; set it to "presentation" or "none" when the badge must not be announced as a live status

cssVars.--badge-bg: Background color (overrides the color and variant)
cssVars.--badge-fg: Text color (overrides the color and variant)
cssVars.--badge-border: Border color of the subtle and outline variants
cssVars.--badge-ring-color: Color of the ring separating an attached (corner) badge from its content (defaults to --surface-color)

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: With an element child the badge is attached to its corner and shows content; with text only it is a standalone badge.

colors-variants.title: Colors, variants and sizes
colors-variants.description: Six colors, three variants and three sizes; border-radius and border-width customize the shape.

positions.title: Positions and dots
positions.description: position picks the corner of the child. A dot badge has no text: give it an aria-label, or badge-role="presentation" when it must not be announced.

slots.title: Icons, rich content and updates
slots.description: The icon slot adds an icon, the content slot rich content. content is a property: click the button to update the count.

props.badgeRole: ARIA role of the badge (default "status"; "presentation" or "none" stops announcing it).

slots.default: Element the badge is attached to, or the text of a standalone badge.
slots.content: Rich content of the badge (instead of content).

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Notification and message badges show 5 and 99+; inline badges mark Inbox 12 and a New changelog.

colors-variants.title: Colors and variants
colors-variants.description: Colors and variants using Badge; the preview follows the selected site theme and palette.
